alterations.description: From scene of artificial respiration of Rosanna by Norman, shots in which Rosanna's bare bust is seen.
Scene of Giulio trying to go closer to Rosanna and Rosanna moving away to avoid him in his room, as also the dialogue by Giulio: 'Put your arms around me and enjoy yourself.'
Lines from the song sung by Taras Bulba: 'They work under covers, And from ladies bed to ladies bed they leap'.

From Filipenko's dialogue addressed to Andrei, the words: 'The plunder is richer and I like the smell of harem girls. But they say these Baltic princes have slop pots of gold, too -and their women have hips like percherons.'
In the scenes of revelry, all near-views of bare leg and thigh of a girl and all shots of Bulbas grabbing a girl, spinning her around and falling over and passionately embracing her.
Frontal shots of Yvonne as she is running towards Monica, in which her bust is shown clearly.
Fight between Bimbo and Kovacs in the circus tent, particularly deleting the shots where they thrust hands in each other's faces.
Scene of Krishnan Kutty refusing to go to 3 persons, up to and including Rajathi telling him that he was being brave after all the men have gone.
Song 3 - (Dream Song) - mid-close-shot of the dancer on the background music before the last verse.
Boy taking up the bidi and blowing smoke.
At the police station, delete the Inspector informing Raghu that he would be fined from Rs. 2 to Rs. 5 and offering money with a speech, up to and including Raja accepting it.
Song 5 - (Veettukku Vandha Muchan) - Krishnan Kutty and Rajathi bumping each other (on the background music after the second verse).

Rajil giving a false statement to the police Inspector; the Inspector's speech that he could forgive the accused only when he resigned his post; and the portion of the crowd scene at the police station where Krishnan Kutty is pushed out.
Scene of Krishnan Kutty and Rajathi at the beach in full, up to and including Melapalayathal being taken away by her nephew for dinner.
During song No. 1, two shots of a bare-breasted woman.
Assault by Thangachen on Rebecca reduced to a bare suggestion.
Thangachon paying money to the two men. Reel 14 - Portion where he pays the balance.
Scene of Kariachen paying money to Lazar and asking him to give false evidence.
Shots of the policemen missing the hiding Johney.
Song 11 - All shots of the execution of Thangachen.
Voluntary deletion of a total length of 712.02 Metres.
Scene of Azad on way to Allahabad, raid by police and ensuing encirclement of Azad by the police etc.
